title: Baa Juice Lemon Lime Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Lemon Lime Shortfill offers a clean citrus hit with the sharpness of Lemon balanced by bright, zesty Lime. The mix is simple yet striking, ideal for fans of refreshing fruit blends. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills recreate the impactful character of bar-inspired blends in a long-fill format, perfect for cloudier sessions with sub-ohm devices.
